<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
dat <- read_csv("Automated_Speed_Enforcement_Camera_Removal_–_Monitoring_Speed_Data.csv") |>
  mutate(Month = parse_date_time(Date_of_Data_Collection, orders = "BY"),
         AvgSpeed = if_else(AvgSpeed == "N/A", NA, AvgSpeed) |> as.numeric())
```

Drop missings on month and AvgSpeed -- the latter also removes a bunch of zeros on the compliance variable:


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-output-begin  -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin eyJkYXRhIjoiYGBgclxuZGEgPC0gZGF0IHw+XG4gIGRyb3BfbmEoTW9udGgsIEF2Z1NwZWVkKSB8PlxuICBtdXRhdGUoTG9jYXRpb25Db2RlID0gTG9jYXRpb24gfD4gc3Ryc3BsaXQoc3BsaXQgPSBcIiAtIFwiKSB8PiBtYXAoZmlyc3QpIHw+IHVubGlzdCgpKVxuYGBgIn0= -->

```r
da <- dat |>
  drop_na(Month, AvgSpeed) |>
  mutate(LocationCode = Location |> strsplit(split = " - ") |> map(first) |> unlist())
```

<!-- rnb-source-end -->


<!-- rnb-output-end -->

<!-- rnb-chunk-end -->


<!-- rnb-text-begin -->


Make a pic:


<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-output-begin  -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
da |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Month, y = PctCompliance)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(
    data = tibble(Month = as.Date("2025-11-01"),
                  event = "Camera deactivation"),
    aes(xintercept = Month, colour = event),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("Camera deactivation" = "red"),
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = "dashed"))
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Speed-limit compliance (%)",
    title = "Automated speed enforcement camera removal (Ottawa)",
    caption = "Following the approval of Bill 56, Building a More Competitive Economy Act, 2025,\nall automated speed enforcement cameras were deactivated on November 13, 2025."
  ) +
  ylim(0, 100)
```

<!-- rnb-source-end -->


<!-- rnb-output-end -->

```r
da |>
  dplyr::filter(Month > as.Date("2020-01-01")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Month, y = PctCompliance, colour = LocationCode)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date("2025-11-01"), # Monthly data, so 13th doesn't look correct
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Speed-limit compliance (%)",
    title = "Automated speed enforcement camera removal (Ottawa)",
    caption = "Following the approval of Bill 56, Building a More Competitive Economy Act, 2025,\nall automated speed enforcement cameras were deactivated on November 13, 2025.",
    colour = "Location"
  ) +
  ylim(0, 100)
```
